title: Difference-of-Convex Regularization for Graph Learning by Differentiable Programming
abstract: arXiv:2608.12757v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Laplacian-regularized minimization is fundamental in signal processing and machine learning, but is limited by the dense and ill-conditioned nature of the graph Laplacian pseudoinverse. While the Laplacian itself is sparse, its pseudoinverse is dense and often ill-conditioned, rendering direct computation impractical at scale. Moreover, pseudoinverse learning is more challenging than Laplacian learning. To address this challenge, this paper considers the setting where the graph Laplacian is given and proposes a Difference-of-Convex Regularizer (DCR) graph learning framework that approximates the spectral action of the Laplacian pseudoinverse without direct inversion via regularized Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE). By reformulating Laplacian-Regularized Nonnegative Least Squares (LR-NNLS) through a dual representation, DCR decouples pseudoinverse learning from instance-specific inference and enables efficient primal solution reconst

translated_title: 通过可微分编程实现基于凸差正则化的图学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12757v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：拉普拉斯正则化最小化是信号处理和机器学习中的基础方法，但其受到图拉普拉斯伪逆的稠密性和病态特性的限制。尽管拉普拉斯矩阵本身是稀疏的，但其伪逆是稠密的且往往病态，使得直接计算在规模上不可行。此外，伪逆学习比拉普拉斯学习更具挑战性。为应对这一挑战，本文考虑图拉普拉斯给定的场景，提出了一种凸差正则化（DCR）图学习框架，该框架通过正则化最大似然估计（MLE）近似拉普拉斯伪逆的谱作用，而无需直接求逆。通过将拉普拉斯正则化非负最小二乘（LR-NNLS）重述为对偶表示，DCR将伪逆学习与实例特定推理解耦，并实现了高效的原问题解重构。
tldr: 本文提出了一种凸差正则化图学习框架，通过可微分编程和对偶表示，无需直接求逆即可近似拉普拉斯伪逆的谱作用，从而解决了大规模图学习中伪逆计算困难的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Difference-of-Convex Regularization framework for graph learning that approximates the spectral action of the Laplacian pseudoinverse via differentiable programming and dual representation, avoiding direct inversion and addressing scalability challenges in large-scale graph learning.
